name: Flight Mechanics Studio
description: Connect aircraft design choices with flight behaviour. An interactive workspace for exploring how geometry, operating conditions, and aircraft parameters shape performance, stability, and trim.
features: Explore performance curves and flight conditions
Compare aircraft and investigate design trade-offs

name: Course Portfolio Builder
description: Bring a semester's teaching materials together in one organized course portfolio. Collect lecture notes, assessment instruments, graded student samples, and reports in a structure you can adapt to your course or institution.
features: Customize and reuse course folder templates
Review missing items before completing a portfolio
Export a ZIP with a spreadsheet manifest
